title: kith-events: add Cargo deps (tokio-stream, axum, serde)
description:
What: Add tokio-stream to workspace and wire kith-events/kith-store/kithd Cargo deps so subsequent beads compile.

Algorithm:
1. Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]: add tokio-stream = { version = "0.1", features = ["sync"] }
2. crates/kith-events/Cargo.toml [dependencies]: axum.workspace=true, tokio.workspace=true, tokio-stream.workspace=true, serde = { workspace=true, features=["derive"] }, serde_json.workspace=true
3. crates/kith-store/Cargo.toml [dependencies]: add tokio = { workspace=true } (needed for broadcast::Sender<StateChange> field in Store struct)
4. crates/kithd/Cargo.toml [dependencies]: add kith-events = { path = "../kith-events" }
5. Run: cargo check -p kith-events -p kith-store -p kithd

Defensive rules:
- Use workspace=true for all deps already in workspace; never duplicate version pins
- kith-store must NOT add kith-events as dep (circular: kith-events will later need kith-store for replay)
- Only add features actually needed: tokio sync only, tokio-stream sync only
